advisories.title: Legacy authentication is not blocked
advisories.guidance: Block legacy authentication protocols with a Conditional Access policy (CIS 1.1.2).

advisories.title: Administrators are not required to use MFA
advisories.guidance: Require MFA for administrative roles via Conditional Access (CIS 1.1.3).

advisories.title: Disk encryption is not enforced
advisories.guidance: Require BitLocker / FileVault via an endpoint-security or compliance policy (CIS 3.1.3).

remediation.bodyJson: {"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.windows10CompliancePolicy","displayName":"Require BitLocker (autonomy advisory ADV-2026-003)","description":"Proposed by the autonomy advisory signal; approve to enforce disk encryption.","bitLockerEnabled":true,"secureBootEnabled":true}

advisories.title: No app protection (MAM) policy is assigned
advisories.guidance: Assign an app protection policy to prevent corporate data leakage (CIS 4.1.1).
